source_path: Floom original. Written on 2026-10-19 in Claude Code; not derived from an upstream skill. Ideas (not code) from the MIT-licensed standout CLI are credited in the internal comparison note.
note: Parses a WhatsApp Export chat file (iOS or Android, .txt or .zip, any date locale) with the Python standard library and renders a self-contained HTML page plus 1080x1920 PNG story cards. Nothing leaves the device: no network calls, no model calls, and the PNG renderer blocks every outside request. Tests use synthetic chats only. Version 1.1.0 adds the personal edition (all chats, from the WhatsApp Desktop database on a Mac or a folder of exports), share-safe names and PNG-only share cards, and a green default theme. Tests use a synthetic database too.
